title: Small changes skip heavy analysis
requirement: Глобальный архитектурный контекст должен учитываться пропорционально: вопрос или локальное L0 исправление не требует полного Analysis Record, тогда как L1/L2 изменения обязаны пройти analysis gate.
steps: Run `node scripts/analysis-before-decomposition-proof.mjs` against the pre-round-4 scratch: exit 1 (89/93; fresh attach, deferred status, trace mapping and draft trace removal fail).

Delegate L0 with no record: child starts. Delegate a read-only preset: exempt. Attach with explicit legacyAttach:true: exempt. Attach a fresh task without the flag, or use a write preset behind a read-only role label: analysis_required.
Delegate L1 without analysisId: analysis_required, no task row and no child. Deferred requirement: analysis_required.
Raise the design map: L1 architectureImpact:false starts, L2 architectureImpact:true is analysis_stale.
Trace a task, prove the requirement with evidence, then task_close succeeds in a real second-server chat; before proof it is guard_denied; corrupt the record and it fails closed.
expected: 93/93 checks pass and exit 0. L0 starts a child with no record; a read-only preset and explicit legacyAttach:true are exempt; a write preset behind a role label, a fresh attach without the flag and L1/L2 without a ready record are refused; deferred/rejected requirements are refused; a non-architecture L1 survives a moved map while architectureImpact:true is analysis_stale; a non-last traced task closes while the last is refused until proven; malformed records fail closed; a real second server closed a proven task successfully.
